item.title: välkommen!
item.author: your.email@example.com (Your Name)
item.description: It took blood, sweat and tears to bring these words to your screen today. Almost eight hours of grappling with Hugo, watching a two hour youtube video about what github actually does, building this site three whole times because something or the other would go wrong and I had figured that restarting was probably quicker than trying to weed out what went wrong when I have no idea what html or css are. The tutorial that called itself ‘How to build a blog in ten minutes using Hugo and Github’ did not include in its instructions restarting three full times, nor did the guy have to tearfully plead with AI to fix this mess (not something I’m proud of), but, nevertheless, we got here.
